summary.text: Mark Meek is a Democratic state senator from Oregon Senate District 20 who took office in January 2023, previously served in the Oregon House, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A small business owner and Air Force veteran, he chaired the Senate Finance and Revenue Committee in the 2023-2024 session.

paragraphs.text: Mark Meek served in the U.S. Air Force from 1983 to 1990 and earned a bachelor's degree from Park University in 1997.
His career experience includes working as a small business owner.
In a Ballotpedia survey, his campaign described him as the first in his family to graduate high school, and said he lives in Gladstone with his wife.
Meek represented Oregon House District 40 from 2017 to 2023, succeeding Brent Barton.
He then won the Senate seat previously held by Bill Kennemer and assumed office on January 9, 2023.
In the 2023-2024 session, Meek chaired the Finance and Revenue Committee and was co-chair of the Joint Tax Expenditures Committee.
